purpose: Keep RAG and GraphRAG as an explicit future retrieval escalation interface without enabling a live semantic backend during the pre-release debt cleanup task.

backend_state.reason: Current task completes the controlled boundary, not a live retrieval backend. Enabling real backends requires a separate privacy, dependency, data-retention and E2E design.

activation_gate.forbidden_soft_switch: No environment variable, JSON flag, or threshold-only edit may enable a real backend without the activation gate.

allowed_operations_now: validate no package or runtime code claims live backend
forbidden_operations_now: read private raw archives in bulk

must_not_claim: Do not claim RAG is enabled.
Do not claim GraphRAG is enabled.
Do not claim vector search is enabled.
Do not claim disabled adapters provide semantic retrieval.
Do not claim this policy replaces source truth or RedCap Forge.
